root.meaning: Declared physical blade start of this study layout; independent of the 90 mm hub radius and 144 mm first aerodynamic station

budget.cell_order: Mach ascending, then Reynolds ascending; cold process per cell, ALFA ascending
budget.stop: Stop after any incomplete, timeout, execution, provenance or persistence failure. No retry, fallback, cell substitution or re-gridding; a failed cell is retained and ends this protocol version.

deployment_targets.purpose: Section states of the coupled deployment cases this grid is sized for (no-induction estimates from pyfoldable.application.coupled_analysis, 14 m/s, demonstration-assumption mechanics)
cases: fold -22.5 deg released at constant 2400 RPM: swing tip Mach <= 0.354, Re <= 3.59e5 (energy estimate)
fold -20 deg released at 1600 RPM during a 1600->2400 RPM ramp: alpha >= -3.98 deg, root Re >= 1.32e5, root Mach >= 0.082
deployment_targets.alpha_policy: Same attached-flow angle grid as research_axial_800_attached_xfoil_v1; no post-stall extension

supersedes.outcome: Capture stopped at cell 4 (Mach 0.05, Re 330k): alpha 6 deg not converged within 160 iterations (XFOIL VISCAL: Convergence failed; alpha 4 and 8 deg converged). Failure retained in reports/coupled_deploy_polars_20261112/failed_v1/; not installed.
supersedes.change: max_iterations 160 -> 300 only. A converged XFOIL solution does not depend on the iteration cap; grid, angles, transition and executable are unchanged.

relation_to_v1: Separate family. The v1 Re 165k/245k/330k x Mach 0.10/0.31 cells are repeated with this build so the two executables can be compared; no v1 cell is reused or mixed into this table.
scope: Attached-flow NACA2412 section grid widened in Reynolds and Mach for coupled deployment cases of the 800 mm research layout. Unqualified numerical evidence; more XFOIL coverage does not establish validity in separated flow.
